svg.title: Cortex-IA planning flow
svg.desc: Decision flow for a request. It asks whether a plan is needed. If not, it becomes one direct task that is implemented, reviewed and marked done. If so, the planner writes one plan file, docs/plans/<board>.md, with acceptance checks. Its slices become DAG tasks or one sequential task, which are implemented and reviewed against the Acceptance Checks before done.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Small changes run as one task. Larger feature work gets one plan file with executable checks.
